purpose: Training-only direct validation of generated text baseline through the existing AssessmentService/BenchmarkRunner, using exactly its 28 builder inputs against the independent deterministic reference. No holdout, qualification, plugin assessment, savings/admission claim or model turns.
review_findings: Read full source; Python json/sys only; input transport is bounded, no network, subprocess or filesystem calls. Source ignores bare requested labels and trims surrounding whitespace; independent training validation must reveal any semantic mismatch without changing the grader
The generated tool runs only in a pinned offline container with fresh per-invocation state
Expected answers stay in the external case validator; no candidate fixture contains answers

campaign_allowance.explanation: Bounds cover the frozen campaign including setup, warm-ups, grading and reporting. They are reservation ceilings, not measured consumption or execution approval. Early failures can use less. Prior operations are already charged and are not added again. Preparation must finish before a plan is reviewed; unplanned future planning, conformance, reusable-tool construction and interventions require their own reviewed allowances. Production monitoring uses receipts and launches no comparison calls.

budget_preview.explanation: Counts adapter model turns, not internal inference steps. Full planned trials exclude planning, warm-ups and retries. Profiles use fresh conversations per trial; timed trials run sequentially. Early rejection can use less; elapsed time is unknown until measured. Per-operation limits remain enforced.
